Notification
The applications are invited for Teaching positions in the School of Management Studies,
Bhaderwah Campus on lecture basis as per the term and condition laid down by order No.
Adm/TW/C&R/16-2067-2120, dated 17.08.2016. The prescribed qualification is as under:
QUALIFICATIONS:-
Good academic record as defined by the concerned university with at least 55% marks (or an
equivalent grade in a point scale wherever the grading system is followed) at the Master’s
Degree level in the concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian university or an equivalent
degree from an accredited foreign university.
PhD/ JRF/NET/ SLET candidates shall be preferred.
Interested candidates are required to submit their application alongwith resume & qualification
certificates on the email:managementstudiesbc@gmail.com on or before 29th of July, 2024. All
the applicants are required to present themselves for walk-in interview scheduled to be held on
30/07/2024 at 2:00 pm along with the original documents in the School of Management Studies,
Bhaderwah Campus.
Note:
The University reserves the right not to conduct interviews for any of the temporary engagement
on contract basis, advertised, (if circumstances so warrant), without assigning any reason thereof.
Sd/-
I/c Head

TERMS & CONDITIONS
1. The selected faculty shall be eligible for remuneration as per the University norms.
2. The candidate will not be entitled to any other benefits that are admissible to regular
employees of the University of Jammu.
3. This engagement will not vest any right to claim for regular appointments at the University of
Jammu or for continued services in the University.
4. The University reserves the right to terminate this engagement at any time in case of
unsatisfactory performance, misconduct or any other administrative reasons/ compulsions.
5. In case of any dispute or ambiguity that may occur in the process of selection, the decision of
the University shall be final.
6.Candidates must report at Bhaderwah Campus for Walk-In Interview on prescribed date and
time along with all supporting documents in original.
